what: On hover, a faint 1px underline at 40% draws from the left over .37s. On release it erases from the left at the same length and exits to the right (the entry and exit sides match, so the underline flows in one direction). With the same two values, the card photo scales up to 1.08 and back (look: zoom), and the list row’s inner padding shrinks by 8px and back (look: pad). Curve cubic-bezier(.36,.04,.23,1)

options.look: zoom (inner [data-fx-part=zoom] photo grows) · pad(inner padding shrinks) — if omitted, underline
options.--fx-zoom: zoom adds scale, default .08 (card) — Brand theme card .05
options.--fx-pad · --fx-shrink: Resting margin of the pad type (default 32px) and shrink amount (default 8px)

use:
Link ·

from.where: shared.js header menu and footer links (original .underline-link) · index.html article card photos (.article-item-image 1.08·1.05 scale) · theme row (.theme-link inner padding 32 → 24px).
